title: The End of Everything
description: It's a True End. No Terrain. Just the Dragon and It's Void. (Everything is Still Obtainable)
body:
_The End? Or the Beginning?_

_Oh yes. It's Truly_

# The End of Everything

I'm kinda tired and bored of the end's features, and would rather have an infinite void to mess around in. Hey! No need to go thousands of blocks in search of the donut rings anymore. 

That's pretty neat.

## Features
- No Terrain Generation in the END at ALL
- Respawn Anchor Works in the End
- All features of the end are still obtainable for completion and achievements sake
- The Elytra is Craftable with Special Banner Fabric
- Shulker Shell and End Stone is Renewable
- There are no Return Gateways. Make Sure You're Ready
- Find Chorus Flower and Shulker Eggs Preserved in the Ancient City Ice Box
- Dragon Head is Dropped on Death. Make Sure to Catch It!
- No Endermen Spawn in End
